srList.sentence: Methodology Drugs and Chemicals Allopurinol (Mega pharmaceutical, Pakistan), potassium oxonate (Sigma-Aldrich, Germany), and xanthine oxidase, Xanthine. Collection of Plant The bark of Berberis vulgaris was collected from Bahawalpur, cleaned carefully to remove adulterations, and then identified by botanist, Dr Sarwar, The Islamia University of Bahawalpur, Pakistan. Preparation of Plant Extract After proper cleaning, Berberis vulgaris was ground into a powder with the help of a grinder.
